title: ASMR whispered money affirmations for deep sleep · it's already yours (44 min)
description:
Whispered money affirmations for sleep, slow and soft, with long pauses.
The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.
44 min of soft whispering over dim, slow footage, no music.

Chapters
0:00:00 Forty-five minutes of money affirmations, whispered slowly, 
0:07:51 I am allowed to feel safe with what I have today
0:15:07 You gently open your hands to the goodness around you
0:22:59 I shape my days with quiet care
0:30:19 I appreciate the simple warmth of this room
0:37:52 You let your hands rest softly now

Affirmations are words to rest with, not a promise of any outcome.

Also from the creator of this channel: Billionaire High Performance Coach (https://billionairehighperformancecoach.com) and A Player Mode (https://aplayermode.com).
